description: Record a reply to a specific declared question using its local nonce and sender policy.

commands.usage:
usage: orchid answer <qid> <choice> [--nonce <nonce>]
Record only a declared choice while the question is unexpired. When answer_allowlist is configured, its recorded nonce and sender policy are required; --nonce is otherwise optional. This reply records the decision but does not impersonate completion of a prerequisite.
